description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Saffi by tapping and sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Lurrus enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
When Saffi enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.
